description:
We cover the basic rules and then do a demo game of Warhammer 40,000. Brought to you by sponsor Futureproof Terrain with an upcoming Kickstarter for pre-painted terrain that gives you unlimited options https://factionwars.futureproofterrain.com/c/YTBE-POTT11E

The Blood Angels, a chapter of Space Marines, battle the mighty Orks in a demonstration of how to play Warhammer 40,000. 

00:00 Intro
01:57 What You Need to Play
04:56 Basic Rules and Concepts Overview
14:16 Attack Sequence and Dice Rolling
21:25 Making Lists Basics
24:25 Demonstration Game
